# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 92 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 50 | Coptic

---

## Saying 92

Jesus said: "Seek and you will find. Yet what you asked me about in former times and which I did not tell you then, now I desire to tell it, and you do not inquire about it."

---

**Translator's Notes (EMET):**

- The first clause parallels Matthew 7:7 / Luke 11:9 (Q: "seek and you will find")
- Thomas adds a unique second part: Jesus had formerly withheld something; now he is ready to tell it, but they don't ask
- "Former times" — the prior period of Jesus's teaching
- "I desire to tell it" — now willing; the timing of esoteric disclosure
- "You do not inquire" — the disciples' failure to ask at the right moment
- The saying presents a missed opportunity for esoteric teaching — the disciples' passivity is the problem
